name: 62010 · Bethalto, IL
findings: ZIP 62010 (Bethalto) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62010 (Bethalto) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62010 (Bethalto) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62010 (Bethalto) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
